entries.zh: 援引古时旧事以为例证（供写入史册的例）
entries.en: to cite ancient precedent; an example to be set down in a history
entries.notes: L 之 p̄ 为 para 之缩写须展开，R 栏空，释义据 L/H/M 三栏合推。

entries.en: exempted by the privilege of gentle birth (hidalgo)
entries.notes: R 栏“ioalgo”带 [疑]，且 L 首词 exemplo 疑为上条 Exempto 之续写；H 優免 义明确。

entries.en: to drill soldiers; to train troops

entries.zh: 骑兵，马军（H 栏原件空缺）
entries.en: cavalry; mounted troops (Chinese column blank in the original)
entries.notes: H 栏空白，M 与 R 仅存零散音节且互不一致，释义主要据 L“de a caballo”。

entries.en: to exhort people; to encourage and admonish
entries.notes: L“gente”带 [疑]，按通行读法取“a la gente”。

entries.zh: 驱除邪魔，驱鬼（H 栏原件空缺）
entries.en: to expel demons; to exorcise (Chinese column blank in the original)
entries.notes: H 栏空白、R 栏“kiog”后残缺，释义据 L“expeler demonios”及 M 残存音节。

entries.en: to experience; to learn by experience
to explain; to expound, to open up (a matter)
entries.notes: M“guèy”与 H 啓 之常读不合（近于解之白读），L 与 H 义尚可通，存疑。

entries.en: to explain in words; to speak out, to state
